title: Revealing Nighttime Construction-Related Activities from a Spatially Distributed Air Quality Monitoring Network

In this study, through a novel network-based data-driven method, we reveal a likely unintended, nighttime-specific impact of construction activities on elevated coarse particulate matter (PMc) concentrations in a metropolitan area....
